column2: IRI generated by TARQL does not match the taxonomy/ontology concept IRI
column3: Check that IRIs constructed in TARQL BIND statements exactly match the corresponding IRIs declared in the taxonomy/ontology. Identify namespace, path, casing and identifier-pattern differences.

column2: Same IRI used for different concepts
column3: Identify cases where separate layers or datasets generate the same IRI for concepts with different meanings. Surface repeated construction patterns and their class or graph contexts for review.

column2: IRI construction pattern not updated following a model change
column3: Detect where an agreed IRI pattern has changed but TARQL BIND expressions still use the old pattern, particularly when concepts move into a shared or core namespace.

column2: taxonomy/ontology concepts referenced by TARQL do not exist
column3: Check that every IRI generated within a taxonomy/ontology namespace corresponds to a concept present in that taxonomy/ontology, including misspelled or incorrectly constructed references.

column2: Core concepts used inconsistently across domains
column3: Compare how shared or core concepts are used by different domain mappings. Surface significant differences in IRI construction, predicates, class assignment or mapping logic.

column2: Ontology changes not propagated to TARQL mappings
column3: Check whether classes or properties renamed, replaced, deprecated or removed in an ontology are still referenced by TARQL constructs.

column2: Changes not consistently reflected across dependent artefacts
column3: Compare versions of ontologies, taxonomies and mappings to identify changes made in one artefact but not propagated to the others.
